mapper.insert: insert into dh_import_job( job_no, preview_id, dataset_id, operation_type, source_version_id, source_lock_version, target_version_id, rollback_target_version_id, retry_of_job_id, status, phase, source_file_name, stored_file_path, file_type, file_hash, dedup_key, sheet_name, proposed_display_name, proposed_physical_name, schema_snapshot_json, operation_payload_json, total_rows, processed_rows, success_rows, failed_rows, upload_user_id, upload_user_name, expire_time, cancel_requested, create_time, update_time ) values ( #{jobNo}, #{previewId}, #{datasetId}, #{operationType}, #{sourceVersionId}, #{sourceLockVersion}, #{targetVersionId}, #{rollbackTargetVersionId}, #{retryOfJobId}, #{status}, #{phase}, #{sourceFileName}, #{storedFilePath}, #{fileType}, #{fileHash}, #{dedupKey}, #{sheetName}, #{proposedDisplayName}, #{proposedPhysicalName}, #{schemaSnapshotJson}, #{operationPayloadJson}, coalesce(#{totalRows}, 0), coalesce(#{processedRows}, 0), coalesce(#{successRows}, 0), coalesce(#{failedRows}, 0), #{uploadUserId}, #{uploadUserName}, #{expireTime}, coalesce(#{cancelRequested}, '0'), sysdate(3), sysdate(3) )
mapper.select: select * from dh_dataset where dataset_id = #{datasetId} and del_flag = '0' and status = 'ACTIVE'
select * from dh_dataset_version where dataset_id = #{datasetId} and version_id = #{versionId}
select * from dh_dataset_version where dataset_id = #{datasetId} order by version_no desc
mapper.update: update dh_import_job set status = 'PENDING_CONFIRM', phase = '等待确认', sheet_name = #{sheetName}, schema_snapshot_json = #{schemaSnapshotJson}, operation_payload_json = #{operationPayloadJson}, total_rows = #{totalRows}, processed_rows = 0, success_rows = 0, failed_rows = 0, error_message = null, start_time = null, finish_time = null, update_time = sysdate(3) where job_id = #{jobId} and status in ('PARSING', 'PENDING_CONFIRM', 'VALIDATION_FAILED', 'FAILED') and expire_time > sysdate(3)
update dh_import_job set status = 'FAILED', phase = '预览失败', error_message = #{message}, finish_time = #{finishTime}, update_time = sysdate(3) where job_id = #{jobId} and status = 'PARSING'

update dh_import_job set status = 'QUEUED', phase = '等待执行', source_lock_version = #{sourceLockVersion}, sheet_name = #{sheetName}, schema_snapshot_json = #{schemaJson}, error_message = null, processed_rows = 0, success_rows = 0, failed_rows = 0, start_time = null, finish_time = null, update_time = sysdate(3) where job_id = #{jobId} and upload_user_id = #{userId} and source_version_id = #{sourceVersionId} and status in ('PENDING_CONFIRM', 'VALIDATION_FAILED', 'FAILED') and (expire_time is null or expire_time > sysdate(3))
mapper.select: select coalesce(max(version_no), 0) + 1 from dh_dataset_version where dataset_id = #{datasetId}
mapper.insert: insert into dh_dataset_version( dataset_id, parent_version_id, schema_id, job_id, version_no, version_type, physical_table_name, row_count, status, retention_until, create_time ) values ( #{datasetId}, #{parentVersionId}, #{schemaId}, #{jobId}, #{versionNo}, #{versionType}, #{physicalTableName}, #{rowCount}, #{status}, #{retentionUntil}, sysdate(3) )
mapper.update: update dh_dataset_version set status = 'ACTIVE', retention_until = null where version_id = #{versionId} and status in ('ACTIVE', 'ARCHIVED')

update dh_dataset set current_version_id = #{targetVersionId}, current_schema_id = #{schemaId}, row_count = #{rowCount}, active_job_id = null, lock_version = lock_version + 1, update_by = #{username}, update_time = sysdate(3) where dataset_id = #{datasetId} and active_job_id = #{jobId} and current_version_id = #{sourceVersionId} and lock_version = #{expectedLockVersion} and del_flag = '0' and status = 'ACTIVE'

update dh_dataset set current_version_id = #{targetVersionId}, current_schema_id = #{schemaId}, row_count = #{rowCount}, active_job_id = null, lock_version = lock_version + 1, update_by = #{username}, update_time = sysdate(3) where dataset_id = #{datasetId} and active_job_id = #{jobId} and current_version_id = #{sourceVersionId} and lock_version = #{expectedLockVersion} and del_flag = '0' and status = 'ACTIVE'

update dh_import_job set target_version_id = #{targetVersionId}, status = 'SUCCESS', phase = '变更完成', processed_rows = #{processedRows}, success_rows = #{processedRows}, failed_rows = 0, finish_time = #{finishTime}, update_time = sysdate(3) where job_id = #{jobId} and lock_version = #{lockVersion} and status = 'COMMITTING'

update dh_import_job set target_version_id = #{targetVersionId}, status = 'SUCCESS', phase = '变更完成', processed_rows = #{processedRows}, success_rows = #{processedRows}, failed_rows = 0, finish_time = coalesce(finish_time, #{finishTime}), update_time = sysdate(3) where job_id = #{jobId} and status != 'SUCCESS'

mapper.select: select v.* from dh_dataset_version v where v.status = 'ARCHIVED' and v.retention_until < sysdate(3) and not exists ( select 1 from dh_dataset d where d.current_version_id = v.version_id and d.del_flag = '0' ) and not exists ( select 1 from dh_import_job j where j.status in ('QUEUED', 'VALIDATING', 'STAGING', 'COMMITTING', 'RECOVERING') and (j.source_version_id = v.version_id or j.rollback_target_version_id = v.version_id) ) order by v.retention_until, v.version_id limit #{limit}
mapper.update: update dh_dataset_version set status = 'PURGING', purge_claimed_at = sysdate(3) where version_id = #{versionId} and status = 'ARCHIVED' and retention_until < sysdate(3) and not exists ( select 1 from dh_dataset d where d.current_version_id = dh_dataset_version.version_id and d.del_flag = '0' ) and not exists ( select 1 from dh_import_job j where j.status in ('QUEUED', 'VALIDATING', 'STAGING', 'COMMITTING', 'RECOVERING') and (j.source_version_id = dh_dataset_version.version_id or j.rollback_target_version_id = dh_dataset_version.version_id) )
mapper.select: select * from dh_dataset_version where status = 'PURGING' and (purge_claimed_at is null or purge_claimed_at < #{staleBefore}) order by purge_claimed_at, version_id limit #{limit}
mapper.update: update dh_dataset_version set purge_claimed_at = sysdate(3) where version_id = #{versionId} and status = 'PURGING' and (purge_claimed_at is null or purge_claimed_at < #{staleBefore})
